controller_policy.historical_rf4_rule: Any recorded RF4 attempt retains a 10 GiB reservation; this audit changed no task or admission policy.
controller_policy.promotion: promoted_reservation_bytes returns 10 GiB when observed charged worker PSS exceeds task reservation; emergency_interrupt_one uses bracketed worker PSS samples to promote and account for unspent reservation.
controller_policy.reclaim_condition: MemAvailable < host reserve + unspent worker reservations + 2 GiB growth margin

inputs.registry_snapshot_mode: read-only SQLite transaction; hashes bind each selected raw task record

limitations: Phase receipts report aggregate process-tree RSS; admission promotion uses charged process-tree PSS. These metrics are not interchangeable.
The ten observations cover E4 rep 2 only and training rows 91,492–125,955; they are not a worst-case bound.
This does not qualify E4 rep 1/rep 3, other E4 RF profiles, or E5 synthetic RF.
No admission profile, queue state, source file, or model artifact was changed.
